patterns.note: Product feature sections consistently alternate between a large image on one side and descriptive text with a call-to-action on the other, creating a dynamic visual rhythm down the page.
Many sections utilize full-bleed, high-quality product photography as their primary visual element, often with minimal text overlay, to create an immersive and aspirational feel.
A warm, light neutral color palette (light beige/peach and white) dominates the backgrounds, providing a clean canvas for vibrant product colors and a contrasting deep blue footer.

The main navigation bar is initially larger and blends with the hero section, then shrinks in height and gains a solid white background as the user scrolls, remaining sticky at the top of the viewport.
The hero section's content (product image and text) exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slightly slower rate than the scroll, adding depth to the initial view.
A dedicated Instagram feed section is integrated into the homepage, displaying a grid of lifestyle product images under a clear brand handle, linking social presence directly to the site.

technique_notes: Hero sections and key product features utilize full-bleed, high-resolution photography, often with products placed in natural or lifestyle settings, to create an immersive and aspirational feel.

The primary navigation bar is initially larger and blends with the hero background, then shrinks in height and adopts a solid white background as the user scrolls down, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport, likely using CSS transitions.
Product feature sections alternate the placement of large product imagery and descriptive text blocks, creating a dynamic visual rhythm down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold sans-serif, often uppercase, with the hero heading being significantly oversized (~3-4x body text), while body text is a clean, legible sans-serif at a comfortable reading size.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (product cards and buttons feature slight corner rounding, maintaining a soft but not overly rounded aesthetic).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous padding and margins are used throughout, particularly in hero and product feature sections, contributing to a spacious and uncluttered feel).

standout: The site stands out with its aspirational, high-quality product photography that often fills entire sections, creating a luxurious and immersive feel. The consistent use of a warm, natural background palette combined with vibrant product colors gives it a distinctive, premium aesthetic that avoids a generic e-commerce template look.
